description: Returns a list of workflows bulk replace requests.

parameters.name: filters[status]
parameters.description: Filter bulk replace requests with matching status.

parameters.name: filters[old_assignee_ids]
parameters.description: Filter bulk replace requests with any of the matching old assignees.

parameters.name: filters[new_assignee_ids]
parameters.description: Filter bulk replace requests with any of the matching new assignees.

parameters.name: filters[updated_by_id]
parameters.description: Filter bulk replace requests with any of the matching updated by users.

parameters.name: filters[type]
parameters.description: Filter bulk replace requests by replacement type (temporary or permanent).

parameters.name: filters[replacement_type]
parameters.description: Filter bulk replace requests by replacement type. Equivalent to `filters[type]`.

parameters.name: filters[start_date]
parameters.description: Filter bulk replace requests by start date range. Format: ISO 8601 date range "YYYY-MM-DD...YYYY-MM-DD".

parameters.name: filters[end_date]
parameters.description: Filter bulk replace requests by end date range. Format: ISO 8601 date range "YYYY-MM-DD...YYYY-MM-DD".

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sort the results by specified fields. Supported fields: updated_by, status, old_assignee, updated_at, start_date, end_date, type

data.description: List of workflow bulk replace requests

id.description: Unique identifier for the bulk replace request.

status.description: Lifecycle state of the bulk replace request.

replacement_type.description: Whether the replacement is permanent or time-boxed.

new_assignees.description: Assignees that take over the old assignee's workflow assignments.

start_date.description: Date the replacement takes effect. Set only when `replacement_type` is `temporary`.

end_date.description: Date the replacement ends. Set only when `replacement_type` is `temporary`.

modify_project_roles.description: Whether project role assignments are replaced in addition to workflow assignments.

project_ids.description: Projects the replacement is limited to. Empty means every project the old assignee can access.

tools.description: Tools the replacement is limited to. Empty means all enabled tools.

stopped_at.description: Timestamp when the request was stopped. Null if it has not been stopped.

created_at.description: Timestamp when the request was created.

updated_at.description: Timestamp when the request was last updated.

has_errors.description: Whether the request recorded any replacement errors.
